svg.title: Sequence: Doctor calls the next patient

g.text: Sequence: Doctor calls the next patient
Load the shift queue (UC-D2), repeated every 15 s
open a shift from "Lịch trực của tôi"
groups: in examination / waiting / not arrived / done;
"Gọi bệnh nhân tiếp theo" enabled only if nextAppointmentId ≠ null
(+ doctorInExamination: the doctor's open exams that day, all shifts)
update … where id and status = CHECKED_IN
